extDescription.message: On the open Gmail search, selects the visible page, moves it to Trash, then repeats.

dangerousView.message: This view is left alone (Trash, Spam, Sent, Drafts, or Starred).

needSearch.message: Open a search first: the address must contain #search/.

needOlderThan.message: The search needs older_than: of at least 90 days.

blockedToken.message: The search contains $TOKEN$, so it will not start.

queryMismatch.message: The search box does not match a safe search. Press Enter on the search, then Start.

pausedHidden.message: Paused until this tab is visible.

dialogOpen.message: Stopped: a dialog is open. Close it, check Gmail, then press Start.

lookingForRows.message: Looking for rows in the list…

finished.message: Done. No rows left. Batches: $BATCHES$, about $ROWS$ rows.

waitingForList.message: Waiting for the list to update…

dialogBeforeDelete.message: Stopped: a dialog appeared. Delete was not pressed.

noDeleteButton.message: The Delete button did not appear.

listUnchanged.message: The list did not change: Gmail may have ignored the click.

confirm.message:
Moving one page of this search to Trash every 5 seconds.

$QUERY$

Messages stay in Trash for 30 days. You can press Stop whenever you want.

stoppedManual.message: Stopped. What is already in Trash stays there for 30 days.

note.message: One page at a time, then 5 seconds. Mail goes to Trash and is not deleted forever. Keep this tab visible.

ready.message: Ready. Press Start: each cycle selects the page and moves it to Trash.
